note: PUBLIC boolean semantics for the v2 record flags, grounded in the pinned upstream (python-frontmatter 1.3.0). frontmatter_present = the pinned upstream recognised AND stripped a front-matter block when parsing (true even when the block is empty). metadata_nonempty = the parsed metadata contains at least one key. The frozen environment ships no TOML support, so '+++' fences are NOT recognised (frontmatter_present=false). A structurally complete fence whose payload the upstream fails to parse makes the whole batch raise IngestError with code UPSTREAM_PARSE_ERROR.

truth_table.case: unclosed fence — upstream does not recognise it; full original text stays content
